resources.string: Experimental. Buffers the channel you watch full screen so you can pause and rewind it. Uses storage while you watch and needs a free connection like normal viewing. Works with MPEG-TS channels only; HLS channels, multiview, the preview and a channel being recorded play normally. If anything fails, playback falls back to normal live playback.
Shortened when free space is low. The buffer is deleted when you change channel or stop watching.
30 minutes when there is enough free space, otherwise less
Where the buffer is written while you watch
